Application Data.NAME: Sunny Side Diner
Application Data.CONTACT FOR INSPECTION: John Doe, Manager, Sunny Side Diner, 123 Main Street, Springfield, IL 62701-1234, (555) 123-4567
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Sunny Side Diner is a family-friendly establishment located in Springfield, IL, specializing in quick-service meals, breakfast items, and comfort food. Our menu offers a variety of options, including burgers, sandwiches, salads, and breakfast all day. We pride ourselves on providing a warm and inviting atmosphere for families and individuals alike. Our team is dedicated to ensuring quality food and excellent customer service, making us a popular choice for both dine-in and take-out. Additionally, we offer a selection of beverages, including soft drinks and coffee, but do not serve alcoholic beverages. The diner operates with a focus on hygiene and safety, adhering to local health regulations to ensure a safe dining experience for our customers.
